name: rules-decay
title: Which kinds of rule go stale

conditions.source: the author's own session archive; only counts leave it

summary: Whether rules should fade by age or by kind. Fading by age quieted about a quarter of rules that were still true, so ctx fades only status notes, 30 days after their file was last written.

metrics.label: Stale, rules in the person's own words

meaning: Status notes go stale within weeks and rules in a person's own words rarely do, so ctx fades by kind. Fading by age would have silenced about a quarter of rules that were still true.
